title: RedCloud Blockz
body:
RedCloud Blockz improves Minecraft’s visuals and atmosphere without changing gameplay.
It adds smoother animations, upgraded textures, lighting improvements, and immersive weather to make the world feel more alive while keeping the vanilla style.

Features

Smooth character and mob animations

Enhanced block and item textures

Atmospheric weather and lighting

More immersive world visuals

Client-side only, works on vanilla servers
